name: Malthus
source:
AGE: XX | Ex-Reaper

A man with a glib tongue, foul attitude and a dangerous aura. He loves to get the last word in, and even more so, loves to irritate his older brother.

Despite his antics, his priorities are in order, and he will never be found apart from "Lucien."

LIKES
Warm rooms. Cozy spaces. Spicy food. Playing pranks. When Lucien smiles. Aina's...lap. Turkey.

DISLIKES
When it's too cold. Caym. When things are too quiet. Caym. Boredom. Society. Caym.
